name: The Binding
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Using the heartswood core, you will be able to cast a spell at the summoning circle in the crypt below to open a portal for the succubus to pass through.

Be careful, adventurer, succubi have overrun even the strongest of minds.

Once you have bested and returned it to the void, return to me and I will show you how to call and control it.
narrative.objectives: Using the Heartswood Core, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done, well done, adventurer. I see we've done right in deciding to train you. Your performance certainly does not disappoint.

I've no qualms in showing you the way to control your newly bound succubus. Observe carefully.
narrative.requestItemsText: Sometimes I wonder if Surena was not a succubus in disguise, sent to warp and twist my mind... Ha! I give her too much credit, I think.
